comparison.objective: Discharge a capacitor before removing and boxing a power-supply board; candidate commissions a damper while isolated.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-624 tests two-pin contact alignment, sustained contact, and board extraction; candidate tests single-socket hex alignment, rotary adjustment, counterholding, and torque-bounded locking.
comparison.success_condition: PR-624 requires two seconds of pad contact before extraction; candidate requires de-energized adjustment plus two compliant impact cycles. No spec versions exist.
comparison.reason: Both enforce safe sequencing, but their physical skills and terminal outcomes are materially different.
